name: delivery-control
description: Local transactional delivery control for JSON-defined engineering workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Audit, recover, authorize, and close delivery flows
interface.longDescription: Adds a local-only MCP controller for Plan Tree transactions, crash recovery, scoped authorization, evidence gates, and host-plan synchronization or handoff.
defaultPrompt: Use $delivery-control to audit the active delivery flow.
Use $delivery-control to recover this flow and report drift.
Use $delivery-control to inspect completion and authorization gates.
